tumor_behavior.evidence: Sections from the clip site and surrounding fibrotic area show extensive hyalinized fibrosis, foamy histiocytes, hemosiderin deposits, and occasional clusters of tumor cells within the fibrous stroma -- representing residual invasive carcinoma with treatment effect (ypT1a, residual focus approximately 1 mm).
